items.title: Bill Crow interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I play a lot with Carmen Leggio over in Westchester, with Joe Shepley, he’s got a steady Wednesday down in Yonkers, I play with him

ctx.x: Well you seem to keep pretty busy with that and the work in the Local and you still go around this area playing bass.

Oh, yeah, I play at least two nights a week and sometimes more. I play a lot with Carmen Leggio over in Westchester, with Joe Shepley, he’s got a steady Wednesday down in Yonkers, I play with him, and all the guys come by to play with us so I get to play with George Young and Lou Delgado, guys like that, and some young players that Joe knows that are coming along real good. Well I took up the tuba while I was doing Broadway shows. I went back to a brass instrument after 25 years of not having touched one. And I…
Wow. You must be tired by the time it’s done.
